changelog: Role dates now use start_year/start_month/end_year/end_month integers (schema no longer uses SQL DATE for Role — see docs/domain-model.md 'Role date precision'). No fabricated day-of-month anywhere.
Added an `educations` array (3 records) — Education is now a real model owned by CareerProfile.

pearson-marketing-budget-forecast-hours-saved-per-month now has a real bounded-range Metric (value 10, value_max 15) and is verification: verified, not needs_confirmation — the range itself is the confirmed fact. See app/Models/Metric.php 'value_max'.

CareerFact quality-audit cleanup: rocketgate-workflow-intelligence-independently-implemented no longer restates the general 'independently implemented' conclusion (kept once, at Role level, in rocketgate-independently-implemented-from-team-requirements) — trimmed to project-specific Flow/documentation/Jira/credentials context only.

rocketgate-merchant-integration-enablement split into two atomic facts: rocketgate-merchant-integration-technical-contact (meeting merchants, assessing their stack, directing them to the right library/approach) and rocketgate-merchant-integration-testing-troubleshooting (testing payment flows, troubleshooting, answering technical questions).

Removed rocketgate-transaction-remediation-phase1-approved-users and -phase2-approved-users as standalone CareerFacts. Their values (1,780 / 44 approved users) are preserved as scope context in the scope_note of the corresponding -phase1-transactions-corrected / -phase2-transactions-corrected metrics — not lost, just no longer independently reusable 'accomplishments' on their own.

Removed profile-full-stack-engineer-summary — it restated the resume's marketing 'Professional Summary' paragraph (including evaluative language like 'comfortable...deliver reliable, maintainable software') with no information beyond what the Laravel/React/TypeScript Skills and their own project-level CareerFacts already establish with stronger evidence.

field_notes.employer_key / role_key / project_key /: JSON-only cross-reference identifiers for this proposal. They are NOT schema columns — Employer and Role have no stable `key` column in the current schema (see docs/domain-model.md 'Stable identifiers' for exactly how a future importer resolves Employer by (career_profile_id, name) and Role by (employer_id, title, start_year, start_month) instead). Project.key IS the real `slug` column value. Skill.key IS the real `slug` column value. CareerFact.key IS the real `key` column value.
field_notes.roles[].start_year / start_month / end_y: Integers, matching the real schema columns exactly (see app/Models/Role.php). start_month/end_month are null wherever only a year is evidenced — never fabricated. end_month/end_year null together means a current role.
field_notes.educations[].start_year / end_year: Integers, year-only (see app/Models/Education.php) — no source evidences a month for any degree.
field_notes.career_facts[].metric.value_max: Null except for pearson-marketing-budget-forecast-hours-saved-per-month, the one genuine bounded range in this dataset. When present, value..value_max is the range; never a fabricated midpoint.
field_notes._review_comment: Present on some records only. Reviewer-facing context for this proposal. Not a schema field — discard before import.
field_notes._section (within career_facts array only: Objects containing only a `_section` key are pure visual dividers grouping the facts below them by Role/Project, with no CareerFact fields of their own. An importer must skip any object lacking a `key` field — do not attempt to map these to CareerFact rows.

projects.name: Workflow Intelligence
projects.description: A Laravel/Vue platform that unifies Jira work-item and GitLab merge-request/deployment activity into a single workflow model, computing deterministic delivery metrics and evidence-linked dashboards, with AI used only to explain already-computed results. projects.name: Verbatim
projects.description: A grounded documentation Q&A and support-reply-drafting system: retrieval and confidence scoring are deterministic, and an LLM is used only for synthesis over pre-selected source material, with citations mapped back to the exact retrieved section.

projects.name: Transaction Toolkit
projects.description: A local-first investigation and analytics tool that snapshots merchant transaction history locally and supports repeatable analysis across declines, authentication, retries, and concentration, with deterministic reporting by default and optional AI explanation layered on top of pre-aggregated, PII-excluding metrics.

projects.name: Knowledge Exporter
projects.description: A provider-abstracted, read-only export pipeline that converts Freshdesk and Confluence content into deterministic Markdown, using SHA-256 content comparison so repeat runs create, update, or skip files rather than rewriting everything.

projects.name: Transaction Remediation Tooling
projects.description: Production tooling for safely analyzing, planning, executing, verifying, recovering from, and auditing high-risk corrections to a RocketGate merchant's transaction data. Originated as a deterministic donor-lineage backfill for missing location/tax-jurisdiction metadata (source repository: rg-transaction-reconstruction, where it is referred to as 'transaction reconstruction') and grew into a broader, multi-phase remediation engagement. Restricted by default — this concerns a specific merchant's data and process, not a generally applicable platform.
